fusions.name: Reef-Cut Soles
fusions.desc: Spends 4% of your maximum health to stamp coral spurs up through the ground, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaving them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Accretion
fusions.desc: A kick that seeds stinging coral on the target's legs, dealing 28 damage plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. It leaves the target [Leaden] for 8 seconds and [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Sown Spurs
fusions.desc: Grows a bed of coral spurs at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, then deals 14 damage to each of the first 3 enemies to tread within 2 tiles and leaves them [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Shoal Wader

riders.text: you move over it faster than over ground

fusions.desc: You can walk across open water and stand on it.
